title: Medical Advisor Amyloidosis
description:
**Location** Milan, Lombardy, Italy **Job ID** R\-256890 **Date posted** 23/07/2026
  
Are you ready to shape the scientific narrative in amyloidosis and turn robust evidence into actions that change patient outcomes? In this role, you will connect cutting\-edge science with real\-world practice for rare and complex conditions, helping patients receive timely, accurate diagnosis and effective treatment. You will anchor the medical strategy, lead cross\-functional initiatives, and ensure every engagement is scientifically rigorous and fully compliant.


Can you see yourself building trusted partnerships with leading clinicians while guiding studies and education that raise the standard of care? Operating at the intersection of medical affairs, clinical research, and commercial collaboration, you will lead initiatives that strengthen our presence with specialists. With access to global expertise and the agility to move at pace, you will translate complex biology into meaningful impact for people who need it most.


**Accountabilities:**


**KOL strategy and engagement**: Identify, map, and develop Key Opinion Leaders; build trusted scientific relationships that surface insights, inform plans, and enhance external credibility.


**Medical plan and project leadership:** Own delivery of the medical plan and lead local clinical, observational, and diagnostic screening projects with cross\-functional partners—on time, on budget, and with measurable impact.


**Scientific excellence:** Build and continuously deepen expertise in amyloidosis and our therapies; monitor literature and data, then translate learnings into clear guidance, actions, and field enablement.


**Compliance and governance:** Uphold local laws, codes, and internal policies across all materials, activities, and educational programs to ensure ethical, compliant operations.


**Medical education and materials:** Create high\-quality educational content and provide scientific support for the development, review, and approval of materials for scientific meetings, symposia, and other medical education activities.


**Scientific exchange:** Deliver reactive, on\-site scientific presentations; participate in local meetings to educate, gather intelligence, and bring back insights that shape strategy.


**Pharmacovigilance collaboration:** Partner with safety teams to address medical issues related to adverse events, supporting patient safety and effective risk communication.


**Commercial partnership:** Work with marketing and sales to craft scientifically sound promotional messages, supportive documentation, and tailored projects aligned to medical strategy.


**Training and capability building:** Support the Medical Lead in training the sales force and in reviewing promotional materials in line with local regulatory requirements.


**Professional engagement:** Engage with professional societies and external groups to support your development and expand high\-quality field insights that inform our plans.


**Essential Skills/Experience:**


* Proven ability to identify, map, and develop Key Opinion Leaders and maintain strong scientific relationships.
* Experience acting as project manager for medical plans, local clinical studies, observational studies, and diagnostic screening projects with cross\-functional collaboration.
* Demonstrated capability to develop and maintain scientific expertise and familiarity with literature regarding products and the relevant therapeutic disease area.
* Strong knowledge of local laws and guidelines, codes of practice, and company policies related to promotional materials, activities, and educational programs.
* Experience developing educational materials for internal and external medical initiatives in relevant therapeutic areas.
* Track record of delivering reactive medical presentations to customers on site.
* Experience supporting pharmacovigilance activities and managing medical issues related to adverse events.
* Experience collaborating with country marketing and sales teams on promotional messaging, supportive documentation, and customized projects.
* Experience providing scientific support for the development, review, and approval of materials for scientific meetings, symposia, and other medical education activities.
* Experience participating in local meetings for educational purposes and to gather medical intelligence and insights.
* Experience supporting a Medical Lead in delivering medical training to sales teams.
* Experience supporting promotional review processes in alignment with local regulatory requirements.

**Desirable Skills/Experience**:


* Advanced scientific or medical degree (e.g., MD, PharmD, PhD) with focus in amyloidosis or related disciplines.
* Medical affairs experience in diseases or conditions with high unmet need.
* Established network within the community and experience engaging national or regional KOLs.
* Familiarity with diagnostic pathways, screening programs, and real\-world evidence methodologies.
* Excellent scientific communication skills in both local language and English
* Ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment and translate complex data into clear, actionable insights.

**Why AstraZeneca:** Join a team where rare disease focus meets the resources and reach of a global biopharma leader. We bring diverse minds into the same room to spark bold thinking, learn quickly, and stay close to the patient experience—pairing scientific depth with smart execution across the patient journey. You will collaborate directly with scientific leaders, access advanced evidence\-generation capabilities, and see your work travel from strategy to bedside in areas of profound unmet need. We value ambition alongside kindness and integrity, provide high trust with real autonomy, and use in\-person collaboration around three days a week—balanced with flexibility—to connect, work at pace, and challenge assumptions together.


**Call to Action:** If you are ready to elevate amyloidosis care by turning science into meaningful change for patients, step into this role and shape what’s possible with AstraZeneca today!

* Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies
* Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills

Roles within Clinical Monitoring/CRA are responsible for overseeing and ensuring the integrity of clinical research studies by monitoring data and processes from a centralized location. This includes conducting remote monitoring of trial sites to verify compliance with regulatory requirements and clinical protocols. Utilizes data analytics and risk\-based monitoring techniques to identify potential issues and trends, ensuring that trials are conducted in accordance with established clinical practices. Collaborates with site teams to develop and implement tools, procedures, and processes that enhance quality monitoring and support the overall success of clinical trials. Office**Job Description**


At PPD, part of Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life \- enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life\-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100\+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research through our PPD clinical research portfolio, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.


This is a great opportunity for CRA's currently working within the life science sector for pharmaceutical companies, biotech companies or CRO's to work with a world\-leading CRO across multiple sponsors, various protocols and therapy areas.


These roles can be performed remotely for CRA's based close to our clinical 'hubs': **Milan, Bologna, Florence, Rome** and **Naples.** Travel requirement will be national across Italy.


Essential Functions:

* Monitors investigator sites with a risk\-based monitoring approach: applies root cause analysis (RCA), critical thinking and problem\-solving skills to identify site processes failure and corrective/preventive actions to bring the site into compliance and decrease risks.
* Ensures data accuracy through SDR, SDV and CRF review as applicable through on\-site and remote monitoring activities.
* Assess investigational product through physical inventory and records review.
* Documents observations in reports and letters according to timelines using approved business writing standards.
* Escalates observed deficiencies and issues to clinical management expeditiously and follows all issues through to resolution. May need to maintain regular contact between monitoring visits with investigative sites to confirm that the protocol is being followed, that previously identified issues are being resolved and that the data is being recorded in a timely manner.
* Participates in the investigator payment process. Ensures a shared responsibility with other project team members on issues/findings resolution. Investigates and follows\-up on findings as applicable.
* Participates in investigator meetings as necessary. Identifies potential investigators in collaboration with the client company to ensure the acceptability of qualified investigative sites.
* Initiates clinical trial sites according to the relevant procedures to ensure compliance with the protocol and regulatory and ICH GCP obligations, making recommendations where warranted. Performs trial close out and retrieval of trial materials.
* Ensures that required essential documents are complete and in place, according to ICH\-GCP and applicable regulations. Conducts on\-site file reviews as per project specifications.
* Provides trial status tracking and progress update reports to the Clinical Team Manager (CTM) as required. Ensures study systems are updated per agreed study conventions (e.g. Clinical Trial Management System).
* Contributes to the project team by assisting in preparation of project publications/tools and sharing ideas/suggestions with team members.
* Contributes to other project work and initiatives for process improvement, as required.


Education and Experience:

* University degree in a science related field
* CRA Qualified as per the Ministerial Decree dated 15/11/2011 and at least 1 year of independent monitoring experience in clinical development phases II\-IV
* Understanding of ICH\-GCP, EU and FDA requirements
* Fluency in English and in Italian
* Valid Driver's License


Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

* Proven clinical monitoring skills
* Demonstrated understanding of medical/therapeutic area knowledge and medical terminology
* Demonstrated ability to attain and maintain a working knowledge of ICH GCPs, applicable regulations and procedural documents
* Well\-developed critical thinking skills, including but not limited to: critical mindset, in\-depth investigation for appropriate root cause analysis and problem solving
* Ability to manage Risk Based Monitoring concepts and processes
* Good oral and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate effectively with medical personnel
* Ability to maintain customer focus through the utilization of good listening skills, attention to detail and the ability to perceive customers’ underlying issues
* Good organizational and time management skills
* Effective interpersonal skills
* Attention to detail
* Ability to remain flexible and adaptable in a wide range of scenarios
* Ability to work in a team or independently as require
* Good computer skills: solid knowledge of Microsoft Office and the ability to learn appropriate software


As well as being rewarded a competitive salary, we have an extensive benefits package based around the health and well\-being of our employees. We have a flexible working culture, where PPD truly value a work\-life balance. We’ve grown sustainably year on year but continue to offer a collaborative environment, with teams of colleagues eager to share expertise and have fun together. We are a global organization but with a local feel.


Our 4i Values:

**Integrity – Innovation – Intensity – Involvement**


If you resonate with our 4i values above, and ultimately wish to accelerate the delivery of safe and effective therapeutics for some of the world’s most urgent health needs, submit your application – we’d love to hear from you

**Job Description**

Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close\-out

Chart Abstraction activities and data collection

This role can be performed from the following countries: Luxembourg, UK/IE, France, Germany, Italy, Spain. There will be travel required up to 30% of the time, mostly within the EU.  

  

About the Role  

Join Amazon's Employee Experience \& Relations (EXR) team in Europe and play a decisive role in shaping how 12 countries navigate one of the most complex labor relations environments in the world.  

  

As the EU EXR Business Partner (BP) for OPS Central Functions \& RME Tech field, you will develop and own end\-to\-end employee and labor relations strategies for the business populations you cover across the EU. As the EXR Business Partner for those VPs, you will act as a trusted advisor who translates business priorities and challenges to EXR plans and outcomes. You will look closely after the employee experience in scope, and partner with PXT to build convincing improvement strategies. You will support organizational changes and respond to emerging business and risk opportunities at EU level. You will work in close collaboration with other EXR Business Partners, Country Field ER teams, and respective Head of Country ER Leadership to deliver specific country insights and ensure that fair, consistent, and transparent employee experience processes are applied across all operations.

Key job responsibilities  

As an EXR Business Partner, you will be the trusted strategic advisor who translates complex business priorities into actionable employee and labor relations strategies. This role is a strategic advisory and relationship\-driven role where your primary impact comes from:  

* The quality of counsel you provide to senior leaders navigating ambiguous, high\-stakes situations
* Your ability to connect regulatory, operational, and human dynamics into coherent strategies
* The trust you build as the go\-to partner whom VPs seek out before making workforce decisions
* Your judgment in balancing business agility with employee experience and compliance imperatives

\- Advise VPs and senior leaders directly on labor relations risk exposure, regulatory compliance obligations, and employee experience opportunities \- providing clear, data\-backed recommendations that enable timely decision\-making;  

* Identify, assess, and mitigate pan\-EU employee relations risk by leveraging risk frameworks, employee listening mechanisms, site assessments, and workforce analytics to surface trends before they escalate;
* Shape the employee experience across your customer groups by designing targeted interventions, visiting site to get employee’s experience feedback firsthand, testing solutions through local ER partnerships, and scaling what works across the network;
* Navigate regulatory complexity by maintaining deep awareness of evolving EU labor legislation and advising business leaders on compliance implications about strategic projects, mitigation options, and strategic positioning;


\- Lead through influence during critical moments \- including organizational change, workforce restructuring, and crisis situations \- partnering with ER Country Leaders to ensure coordinated, legally sound, and employee\-centric responses;  

* Drive strategic coherence across diverse populations by developing tailored approaches for each business function while maintaining a unified pan\-EU framework that delivers consistency, fairness, and transparency;
* Partner cross\-functionally with PxT, Legal, L\&D, GOLD, and Operations Corporate teams to build leader capability and deliver cohesive employee experience across all touchpoints.

Operational Excellence:  

* Use operational data, EXR metrics, and business KPIs to develop persuasive narratives and evidence\-based recommendations
* Lead and deliver complex, cross\-functional strategy at pan\-EU scale from scoping through execution and measurement of impact
* Deliver innovative solutions that challenge the status quo and drive measurable improvements in employee experience
* Define and track success metrics for EXR initiatives, ensuring accountability and continuous improvement

  

Leadership Capabilities:
  

* Navigate high ambiguity and competing priorities across multiple stakeholder groups with minimal direction, exercising sound judgment to drive outcomes
* Influence senior leaders through data\-driven insights, pragmatic solutions, and deep understanding of their respective business challenges
* Build and sustain constructive, trusted advisory relationships with senior leaders and multiple stakeholders across functions and geographies
* Produce high\-quality written communications that analyse problems, present data\-backed options, and recommend clear paths forward

* Lead authentically through self\-awareness and transparency
* Build a diverse network of leaders across the organization
* Develop strong working relationships with VPs, along with internal and external partners

The EU Employee Experience \& Relations team is a high\-performing, pan\-European function supporting all Amazon Operations business lines to drive employee experience and manage labor relations strategies across the EU Region. Acting as a Center of Expertise, we are committed to building capability, ensuring regulatory compliance, and fostering positive employee relations \& constructive labor relations at scale.
